sqlite_master.name: trg_ai_thread_settings_reject_retired_id
sqlite_master.sql: CREATE TRIGGER trg_ai_thread_settings_reject_retired_id BEFORE INSERT ON ai_thread_settings WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ai_thread_delete_operations op WHERE op.endpoint_id = NEW.endpoint_id AND op.thread_id = NEW.thread_id ) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'thread id retired'); END
